gen-gf-gugi-gf-alexandria: Gugi stands tall and bold, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals, with terminals cut open so each counter flows outward. Alexandria brings wide terminals, the pair's quiet anchor.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-amiko: Letterforms bent from a single length of tubing give Gugi its look, with open-cut terminals and lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Amiko takes over below as a modern sans, terminals pointing outward.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-anek-bangla: Distinctive from the first letter, Gugi holds a flat line weight. Anek Bangla, a contemporary sans with wide s curves barely curled in, gives that heading an approachable partner.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-anek-devanagari: Open-mouthed and modern, the body text sits in a tall middle zone, beneath the tube-thick strokes of Gugi. Anek Devanagari would carry paragraph after paragraph without letters closing up on the eye.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-anek-gujarati: Gugi draws with a pencil-line consistency, tall and distinctive. Where it makes a loud statement up top, Anek Gujarati keeps things clean below, its lowercase rivaling the capitals.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Gugi keeps its joins as slim as a pipe cleaner. Anek Gurmukhi then supplies generous round curves and big open counters, so the heading's bold shapes have clean company.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada brings a contemporary sans with a high x-height, terminals stopping well away from the stem. And Gugi leads with strokes as plain as a stitched thread outline, giving the page its bold voice.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-anek-latin: Gugi stamps out stencil-flat letters, its lowercase climbing nearly to the capitals. Anek Latin mirrors that height, yet holds its letters open rather than curled shut, a quieter sans-serif.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-anek-malayalam: Bold yet smooth, Gugi gives every line a tube-like look. Anek Malayalam reads smoothly over many lines, its curve tips left open and caps sitting close to the lowercase.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-anek-odia: A rope-like line that never swells or thins defines Gugi, built for loud, distinctive display. Anek Odia does the quieter work, keeping its rounds unlatched and its capitals just above the lowercase.
